_llm_instructions: قم بتعبئة 'project_title' و 'date_prepared'، بالإضافة إلى خصائص 'value' لكل حقل في نموذج سجل القرارات هذا بناءً على سياق المشروع.

Category.guidance: Document the type of decision, such as technical, project, process, etc.

Decision.guidance: Provide a detailed description of the decision.

Responsible party.guidance: Identify the person authorized to make the decision.

الأولوية.guidance: Enter the date the decision was made and authorized.

التعليقات.guidance: Enter any further information to clarify the decision, alternatives considered, the reason the decision was made, and the impact of the decision.
